introduction.heading: Learning becomes more meaningful when you build with it.
introduction.body: I'm Selvarajalingam — a Technology Educator, Software Developer and Product Builder. My work brings together continuous learning, practical teaching and independent software development.
introduction.philosophy: Technology is not just about writing code. It is about learning continuously, solving problems, building meaningful things, and sharing knowledge that helps others do the same.
